Point-query locality concernsg=Qf,not finite-time observed Markov closure. Signed query may have unbounded stopping depth;moment/mean costs are not hard deadlines. Finite intervention controls terminal or selected GRID laws,NOT all continuous-time paths,first passage or event counts;temporary excursions can differ despite grid agreement. Error must include OUTGOING INFLUENCE:bounded incoming neighbourhood alone fails on the source star example. Rate-table matrix inverse is a stronger comparator for whole-table acquisition;tree advantage is exact individual query without enumeration/editing,not table superiority. Four calibrated intervals have joint99% coverage;temporary-copy99% certificate is SEPARATE,not an unallocated joint claim. Improvement over native is not intervention optimality. Passive counterexample has a DISCRETE hidden mode,not an exclusively continuous bath,and equal linear ENDPOINT response does not imply equality for every multi-time path functional. Finite-state intervention theorem is not transferred to the diffusion. No historical priority,working physical system or civilisation-scale consequence established.
